changes.REVIEW_CENTER_001: A single informative Review Center is reused after full completion, partial close, and from History; rows show original question number, states, topic, and entity when available.
changes.REVIEW_FILTERS_001: Review filters include incorrect, No sé, question-level doubt, notes, personal marks, review flags, and audit state, with subset navigation preserving original session position.
changes.QUESTION_DOUBT_001: The ? marker is question-level rather than per-alternative, with synchronized controls above the question and after the explanation; it does not create notes or audit flags.
changes.DAY_BOUNDARY_001: Continue-later sessions expire on the next local day. Answered sessions become partial history; empty sessions are abandoned. The transition creates zero new attempts.
changes.DAY_BOUNDARY_PT409_001: Status-only day-boundary closure never calls attempt materialization and never creates a recovery on a revision-only conflict; it re-reads remote status/revision and retries status only.
changes.ANKI_OBSERVATION_001: Content/doubt review flags require an associated learning note; learning notes can only be resolved with CREATE_NEW_CARD, UPDATE_EXISTING_CARD, or REEXPOSE_EXISTING_CARD. Legacy outcomes remain readable only.
changes.REVIEW_SCOPE_001: Review flags explicitly distinguish CONTENT from EDITORIAL_TECHNICAL; only content/doubt enters the mandatory Anki reinforcement flow.

supabase_migration.purpose: Adds question_review_flags.learning_scope and permits REEXPOSE_EXISTING_CARD in question_learning_notes.anki_action without touching user attempts, memory, questions, or taxonomy.
